description: This file defines the One2MRelationship class, which represents a one-to-many table-based relationship within a CRM system, extending functionality from a parent M2MRelationship class, including methods for adding and removing entity relationships.

classes.name: One2MRelationship
classes.description: Handles one-to-many relationships in the CRM data model, supporting relationship creation and management, including self-referencing relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the relationship object, setting link definitions based on relationship type and modules involved.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between two beans, handling self-referencing and non self-referencing cases appropriately.

methods.name: addSelfReferencing
methods.description: Overrides parent method to disable self-referencing addition logic, as custom logic is implemented in add().

methods.name: removeSelfReferencing
methods.description: Overrides parent method to disable self-referencing removal logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Sets up link definitions and relationship properties during object creation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new relationship between two beans, updating links considering self-referencing or standard relationships.
